phase: Results-unread proposal after root started comparison; not global pre-experiment registration
scope: Finite 12-shape proposal and bounded attributes, not unknown object mesh generation or widget validation

pilot_candidate_conditions.scoring_note: Use frozen independent scorer; driver contract_ok is not authoritative. Unsupported runtime and unattempted cases remain separate failures; no tuning on these 24 cases.

standard_widget_adoption_conditions.note: Engineering numbers inherit existing widget-first proposal, are not achieved values or statistically validated comfort thresholds.

failure_disposition.memory_over_budget: Keep artifact and raw results; possible optional manual/teacher experiment, not standard widget
failure_disposition.quality_under_target: Keep result, reject default selection, train/evaluate on new independently frozen cases only
failure_disposition.runtime_unsupported: Record software incompatibility, do not convert to a semantic wrong answer only
failure_disposition.startup_or_query_timeout: Record timeout and unattempted cases; do not silently omit
